thread.title: Nasdaq slumps 3%, on track for worst day in nearly two months

author: morningstar.com
title: Nasdaq slumps 3%, on track for worst day in nearly two months
text:
The Nasdaq Composite Index tumbled on Monday, turning negative for the year as technology and internet stocks slumped in a steep decline. The index lost 3%, which is set to be its biggest one-day percentage drop since Feb. 8, as well as its sixth daily drop of the past eight sessions. At current levels, the Nasdaq is down 10.2% from a recent peak, according to FactSet data. Technology stocks were the biggest drags of the day; the sector lost 2.6%, with Google-parent Alphabet Inc. (GOOGL) down 3.1% and Microsoft Corp. (MSFT) shedding 3.3%. Apple Inc. (AAPL) was down 1.4%. Also weighing on the group was Amazon.com Inc. (AMZN), which shed 5% as President Donald Trump continued to tweet against the online retailer (http://www.marketwatch.com/story/trump-tweets-dial-up-attack-on-amazon-and-the-lobbyist-and-fake-washington-post-2018-03-31). The Dow Jones Industrial Average fell 2.4% while the S&P 500 was down 2.6%.
-Ryan Vlastelica; 1337ET
